TRIP STYLE

Inshore & flats

Fish sheltered bays, estuaries, mangroves or shallow saltwater flats. The water and tide shape the day.

Find this style on the atlas ↗

Who it suits

Anglers who want short casts, shallow water and a smaller-boat trip.

Boats & gear

Skiffs and bay boats are common choices. Match spinning or fly tackle to the target, cover and wind.

Seasons

Ask about tide, water clarity and wind as well as the month.
